C1411.title: South Korea Makes First Arrest and Prosecution in Meme Coin Rug Pull Case
C1411.summary: South Korean prosecutors have filed the country's first lawsuit against a Solana meme coin project team for allegedly raising funds through a decentralized exchange and then abandoning the project, causing investor losses.
